sources.title: Election Commission of India — Kerala Assembly General Election 2026 results
sources.role: authoritative latest-election result pages; 13 Kozhikode AC pages linked from each 2026 record

limitations: No invented or AI-generated candidate portraits are included. Reusable, identity-checked photographs are imported separately with source, author and license; many candidates still have no reusable portrait.
Current polygon layer is non-authoritative Datameet/ECI-derived data and should not be treated as a legal delimitation map.
Current-boundary history is intentionally limited to exact current AC numbering/name records from 2011, 2016, 2021 and 2026; earlier results remain legacy-seat records.
Pre-2011 records are retained only under unmappedHistorical because pre-delimitation constituency boundaries/numbers changed; they are never attached to current polygons.

2026 winner records are checked against ECI Trends & Results pages (last updated 5 May 2026); ECI states final Form-20 data is shared separately, so this is not a claim that every displayed secondary candidate row has been independently reconciled.
Election years with no current-boundary row remain represented in years and are not backfilled.
This archive covers documented general-election years; it is not a complete by-election archive. Historical district and constituency coverage is not asserted to be exhaustive.
